description.zh: ⼈物库描述。最⻓⽀持512字符，不限中英文。
description.en: Person library description. Supports up to 512 characters, including both Chinese and English characters.

description.zh:
⼈物库ID。⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库，由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性。

注意不能与系统⼈物库ID相同 ，如相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过[列出人物库所有人物和人脸信息](~~187787~~)接口查询。
description.en:
Person library ID. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person library. It is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness.

Note: This ID must not be the same as any system person library ID. If it matches a system ID, the system person library will be used by default. The ID can contain up to 120 characters, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive. You can query this using the [List all persons and face information in a person library](~~187787~~) API.

description.en: Person library name. Supports up to 512 characters, including both Chinese and English characters.

description.zh:
⼈物ID。⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性。

最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过[列出人物库所有人物和人脸信息](~~187787~~)接口查询。返回FaceId为String类型。
description.en:
Person ID. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person. It is generated by the caller, who must ensure its uniqueness.

The ID can contain up to 120 characters, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is case-insensitive. You can query this using the [List all persons and face information in a person library](~~187787~~) API. The returned FaceId is of type String.

description.en: Person name. Supports up to 512 characters, including both Chinese and English characters.

title.zh: 添加⾃定义⼈物库或⼈物标签
title.en: Add labels to a custom person library or a person

descriptions.zh:
给⾃定义⼈物库或⼈物贴标签，有两种⽤法：

- 指定CategoryId，设置CategoryName和CategoryDesc 。
- 指定PersonId，设置PersonName和PersonDesc 。

两种可以同时设置，也可⼀次设置⼀种。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can add labels to a custom person library or a person in two ways:

- Specify CategoryId, and set CategoryName and CategoryDescription.
- Specify PersonId, and set PersonName and PersonDescription.

You can set both at the same time or set only one at a time.

## Queries per second (QPS) limit
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 100 requests per second per user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Call the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts tag-custom-person --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --category-name CategoryNametest-0000 --category-description CategoryDescription001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --person-name PersonNametest-0000 --person-description PersonDescriptiontest-0000 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
